name: qf_walkie
character: A hand-held two-way radio on the Villain's side of the story: a squelch pop opening each transmission, a band-limited carrier of static that is never words, a roger beep and a squelch tail closing it; the five transmissions differ in level, length and tone.
note: No speech is synthesised. The carrier is noise (a pulse train with 95 % noise) amplitude-modulated at 5.5 Hz through two sets of formant bands (a bright one and a darker, farther one) and the telephone band, driven lightly; the squelch tail is the burst of static after a transmission ends; the beep is 1.2 kHz for 90 ms. ESTIMATE: the 300-3400 Hz band is the telephone band (no source gave the radio passband), narrowed to 2.8 kHz after a listening note; every level and formant is a starting value
